title: Mars Outpost
subtitle: MARS NOTEBOOK  /  One small base. One giant leap.
save_failed: 保存できませんでした
sun_desc: +2 solar power. A good day for science!
calm_desc: Keep your outpost running, one job at a time.
dust_desc: Solar power is halved. Check your batteries.
flare_desc: Strong radiation. Choose how to protect your crew.
archive: Inspired by NASA: May 14, 2024 · X8.7 flare
solar_desc: Makes power automatically. Crew add extra power.
greenhouse_desc: Survival +6 / crew every 5 working days (1 power/day)
lab_desc: Use power to reach your research goal.
habitat_desc: Give crew a rest to restore health.
mine_desc: Use power to gather building materials.
shield_desc: Protect your crew from flares. Costs parts to build.
shelter_info: Skip work and spend 3 power for safety.
need_material: Not enough parts. Try a mining station.
no_crew: No crew on standby. Return someone from a building.
assigned: Crew assigned. They work when you end the day.
sheltered: Everyone is sheltering. No work today.
restart_body: This replaces your current saved outpost.
help_body:
1. Click a crew icon, then a building to assign.
2. Click assigned crew, then another building to move.
3. Pick a building on the right, then an empty tile.
4. Survival resources: −2 daily. Water: +1 daily.
5. Plants: +6 every 5 working days per crew at level 1.
6. Check the forecast beside Next day.

Survive 15 days and collect 30 research to win.
Negative survival/power or zero health ends the mission.
Crew and power are required. Sheltering pauses production.
sources_body:
Warnings are inspired by NASA SDO’s observation
of an X8.7 flare on May 14, 2024, not live weather.

Survival combines water and food into one game resource.
Resource units, production and health effects are
game balance, not NASA measurements.
log_start: Touchdown! Assign your crew and start your first day.
shortage: Not enough power for every building to work.
protected: You sheltered safely through the flare!
loss_body:
A resource or health ran out.
Check forecasts and try a different crew plan.
win_body:
15 days survived. Research goal reached!
You are a resourceful outpost commander.
